answer: A photocopied transit plate must not enroll two keys. Each applicant is assigned one numbered pad on a published dark-sky grid, bound to one live key. In a 13-minute window they train a serialized vine-mounted slit on the catalogued comet and record the 433-nm violet line. Clerks post H=sha3-256(addr||pad_id||vine_serial||comet_id||line_nm). Fee is 0.29 POA; a 19 POA bond lasts eleven epochs. Auditors overlay slit tape on the pad camera and re-fit the line to the comet ephemeris. A reused pad, borrowed vine mount, or missing violet line seizes the bond and benches both keys for sixteen epochs.
